description: HesabYar Phase 5-4 (۵ث — Cheque module): account_check_ir Tryton module + cheque lifecycle with atomic journals, site intake (cheque.received.registered), Sayyad reconciliation (Fintech legal / Ehrazino+SMS natural), clearing matching, collateral cheques off-balance-sheet, storage custody, 17 cheque reports + UI. Design: phased-design-checklist-2026-11-17.md §1.3 ۵ث + §5 (+ batch-1 additions). ADR 0003 decision 7. Follows Phase 5-3 (۵پ) in the standing chain.

acceptanceCriteria: ADR 0004 (or dated ADR 0003 amendment) ACCEPTED approving canonical event names cheque.received.registered + cheque.received.cancelled (beyond the 9 in spec §10.2) and the internal (non-canonical, dashboard-only) cheque cycle events; the ADR names the 15-field envelope + X-HesabYar-Event-Type header contract from US-501

acceptanceCriteria: Lifecycle implemented exactly per §5 §2.1: registered (intake, NO journal) → held (سند ۱: اسناد دریافتنی نزد صندوق / حساب‌های دریافتنی, or پیش‌دریافت مشتری for prepayment) → in_clearing (سند ۲, bank destination chosen + storage_location → bank + custody_log entry) → cleared (سند ۳: نقد و بانک / در جریان وصول) or bounced (سند ۴: حساب‌های دریافتنی or چک‌های برگشتی per installation setting / در جریان وصول, reversal in the CURRENT period, bounce reason + date + bank certificate/inquiry receipt recorded, dunning notification, customer history) → returned (no journal); held → endorsed (سند ۵: حساب‌های پرداختنی / اسناد دریافتنی نزد صندوق, Sayyad transfer registration required); held → returned (سند ۶); registered → expired_unreceived (configurable deadline, default 7 days; Procrastinate reminders day 3 + day N-1; record never revives — new registration with the same sayad_id); registered → rejected_mismatch (never confirm on mismatch)
Atomicity tested: a failed transaction leaves neither journal without state nor state without journal (failing-transaction test)

Pre-acceptance before held: item matching (sayad-serial inquiry) + issuer credit (color + back-cheques); red/brown color or high in-transit commitments → installation policy (reject or manager approval); a white color is NOT a guarantee (warning in UI)

Manual entry form (same 24 fields + validations as the site payload): storage_location, branch, linked invoice, linked installment leg when paying an installment by cheque; manual leaf-receipt confirmation (registered → held) with the four Sayyad items checklist + inquiry receipt attachment; manual clear confirmation; manual bounce reason + non-payment certificate; manual scan/photo upload; manual sayad_status until the API is live

REST endpoints (each one call into account_check_ir via AccountingEnginePort): POST /api/v1/cheques, POST /api/v1/cheques/{id}/deposit, /clear, /bounce, /endorse, /return, /confirm-receipt; scopes cheques:read, cheques:write, cheques:transition added to the catalog
Policy gate (F3/F4): every auto-created journal passes the three-layer gate (event type + amount cap + period lock); draft by default, auto-post only with explicit opt-in
userStories.description: Received commercial cheques (kind=received, purpose=payment): full lifecycle with one atomic Tryton transaction per transition (state + journal together, never one without the other), manual entry first, REST endpoints + scopes.
userStories.notes: §5 §2.1 + §2.4 (journal table سند ۱–۶) + §5 (manual entry). Bounced-cheque re-presentment (bounced → in_clearing) stays DISABLED (UNVERIFIED, §9.1 #5). The installment_leg two-way test (clear marks the leg paid, bounce marks it unpaid) needs ۵ج — implement the link + leg-status hooks now, test with a real installment_leg in ۵ج (deferred cross-phase test, recorded).
userStories.title: Cheque core: received commercial lifecycle + atomic journals + manual entry

acceptanceCriteria: Issued lifecycle per §5 §2.3: issued (سند ۱۰: حساب‌های پرداختنی / اسناد پرداختنی; checkbook + bank account recorded) → cleared (سند ۱۱, triggered by statement matching) or bounced (سند ۱۲) or voided (سند ۱۳: اسناد پرداختنی / حساب‌های پرداختنی; leaf marked voided in the checkbook, appears in report 8); issued collateral mirrors §2.2 in the issued direction (اسناد تضمینی نزد دیگران)

Collateral (received) per §5 §2.2: registered → held (سند انتظامی ۷: اسناد تضمینی دریافتی / طرف حساب‌های انتظامی — memorandum ONLY) → returned (سند انتظامی ۸, reverse); held → called_in converts collateral to commercial with TWO simultaneous journals in ONE transaction (سند ۹الف reverse-memorandum + سند ۹ب commercial recognition) and then follows §2.1 — called_in REQUIRES accountant approval per case (§5 §4) and the design is flagged accountant-gated

Collateral segregation TESTED: a collateral cheque appears in NO commercial report, no receivables/payables balance, no cash forecast, no sales or tax report — only memorandum accounts + report 6 (with the secured_obligation dimension: which obligation each collateral cheque secures)

Endorsement: held → endorsed to a supplier (سند ۵) and to another person (endorsee_type=other, shown separately in report 5); the endorsement-to-other journal design is accountant-gated (§9.1 #12) — implement the transition + Sayyad transfer registration + review-queue filing for the journal, never a guessed journal

Unexpected call-in of an ISSUED collateral cheque (counterparty took it to the bank without notice): immediate alert + withdrawal matching from the bank statement (withdrawal with leaf number) + conversion to commercial with memorandum reversal + commercial journal (mirror of §2.2 issued direction); the exact journal design is accountant-gated (§9.1)

Checkbook page: leaves used/voided/remaining + Fintech chequebook-inquiry (simulator until B3 live); storage_location recorded at held (installation-configurable default) and custody_log tracks every cashbox↔vault↔bank move with actor + time; a custody move is a custody event, NEVER a journal; cash-box counting (§6) agrees with the cheque registry on the cashbox/vault leaf list
userStories.description: Issued cheques (kind=issued), collateral cheques (purpose=collateral) kept strictly off-balance-sheet, endorsement to supplier and to other persons, checkbook leaf tracking, physical storage location + custody log.
userStories.notes: §5 §2.2 + §2.3 + §1.1 (storage/custody) + §4 (approvals). Do NOT design the bounced-endorsed-cheque journal or the endorsement-to-other journal from guesses — both are accountant-gated (§9.1 #3, #12); build the transition + review filing + gate, record the gap honestly.
userStories.title: Issued cheques + collateral (off-balance-sheet) + endorsement + custody

acceptanceCriteria: cheque.received.registered ingested via the generic store connector (US-511/US-512 paths): HMAC webhook receiver + 15-minute polling + daily reconciliation; 24-field payload (14 mandatory + 10 optional incl. installment_leg_id) validated fail-closed at the adapter boundary (sayad_id exactly 16 digits, issuer_national_id 10/11 digits, amount_toman > 0, due_date >= issue_date, purpose payment|collateral only); Toman→Rial ×10 at the connector boundary; payee_national_id must match the mapped company (a cheque payable to another business is rejected); sayad_registered=false → sayad_unconfirmed flag + explicit 'do not accept an unregistered cheque' warning (unified precedent 870)

Site registration creates EXACTLY ONE HesabYar cheque (never zero, never two): DB unique constraint on sayad_id; identical re-registration → idempotent OK; different payload → conflict to the review queue (spec §10.4); dual-entry convergence: a site-registered cheque later entered manually becomes ONE record, not two

Intake is a CLAIM: record in state registered with source site|manual and NO accounting journal — verified by test (a registered record has no move); the first journal is issued only at the held transition, when the physical leaf has arrived and Sayyad registration is confirmed

Three-way mismatch matrix (site vs leaf vs Sayyad) on amount/date: NEVER confirm on mismatch; exceptions filed to the unified review queue as cheque types: three-way mismatch, duplicate sayad_id, cancellation after held, stale in-clearing, never-arrived cheque, ambiguous matching
cheque.received.cancelled from the site: before held → void the intake; after held → review queue (manual return, never automatic void)
Scan from scan_url downloaded into the HesabYar filestore; QR on the Sayyad leaf supported for sayad_id capture without typing errors (site app/form)
Intake queue in the UI: registered cheques awaiting the leaf (with age), day-3 and day-N-1 reminders via Procrastinate jobs
userStories.description: Cheques registered on the store site flow into HesabYar as claims — an intake record with NO journal until the physical leaf arrives and Sayyad confirms. Webhook + polling + daily reconciliation, 24-field payload, three-way mismatch matrix, dual-entry convergence on sayad_id.
userStories.notes: §5 §1.2 + §6 (dual-entry) + §2.1 (registered state). Depends on US-511/US-512 (store connector, DONE in ۵ب) and US-531 (registry). The 24-field payload count is authoritative (the '22' in round-2 report was wrong; installment_leg_id is the 10th optional field from batch 1).
userStories.title: Site intake: cheque.received.registered + intake queue + dual-entry convergence

acceptanceCriteria: Layer 1 (legal): Fintech Sayyad scopes wired through a SIMULATOR + manual fallback (same pattern as US-404 Moadian): cheque-status-inquiry, sayad-serial-inquiry, transfers-chain-inquiry, cheque-color-inquiry (+legal), back-cheques (+legal, incl. bounce reason), chequebook-inquiry, ac-sayad-issue-cheque, ac-sayad-transfer-cheque + the sms-* versions; NO production Fintech call without credentials — live connectivity comes with the ۵ت remainder (B3); the two different 'in-transit' meanings are kept apart (Sayyad in-transit ≠ accounting in_clearing; clearing status comes ONLY from the bank statement)

Layer 2 (natural): Ehrazino color API (verify the integration shape first — endpoints/auth/format — before implementing; color is issuer history only, NOT a statement about a specific leaf); structured cheque_inquiry_receipts model (cheque_id, channel sms|cbi_website|bank_app|payment_app|finnotech_api|ehrazino_api, inquiry_type, requested_at, responded_at, result_code, result_summary, reference, recorded_by, cost_irr — SMS 350 Toman = 3,500 Rial); MANDATORY receipt rule: every important transition (esp. registered → held) needs at least one item/status receipt, else the transition is recorded with a warning and appears in the mismatch report

NO raw PII stored: only verdict/code/time from Fintech inquiries (contract rule: 'فقط برای استفادهٔ لحظه‌ای مجاز است'); no raw inquiry response, no full national IDs in logs; color recorded as a point in time (inquired_at shown in UI — last week's color is not valid for today's decision); decision logic on the NUMERIC color code 1–5 (count-based scale), never on amount thresholds (secondary sources disagree)

Layer 3 (clearing matching) on the US-514 statement-import infrastructure: keys in strength order — exact amount in Rial (MANDATORY, zero tolerance), leaf number in the transaction description (per-bank extraction rule, UNVERIFIED for Melli — falls back to probable), date window [deposit date, deposit date + configurable clearing window], destination bank account (mandatory), transaction direction (mandatory); four confidence levels: exact (all keys — auto-clear with auto-post policy, else draft + one-click confirm), probable (no leaf number — review queue), ambiguous (several same-amount cheques — NEVER guess; review queue with candidate list), unmatched (stays in_clearing + aging report)

NEVER auto-bounce: in_clearing → bounced requires a bank document (non-payment certificate) or an inquiry; a stale in-clearing cheque stays and only appears flagged in the aging report (report 4); partial clearing does not exist — a mismatched deposit is unmatched + manual follow-up, never a partial clear

Issued-cheque clearing: pass/bounce matched against withdrawals (exact amount + leaf number + window + account); reconciles the deposit move line with the cheque's in-clearing move line via account_statement's reconcile
userStories.description: Three-layer Sayyad reconciliation (Fintech for legal entities, Ehrazino + structured SMS receipts for natural persons, bank-statement clearing matching) + automatic clearing matching with four confidence levels. Simulator + manual fallback by design — no production connectivity without credentials.
userStories.notes: §5 §1.3 + §1.4 + §1.5 + §3.5 (never store). Fintech scope field shapes are UNVERIFIED (§9.2 #1–3) — the simulator uses the documented scope names only; no field is guessed. Browser automation / RPA for the CBI form or bank apps is explicitly NOT built (ADR 0003 + §5 §1.4).
userStories.title: Sayyad reconciliation (3 layers) + clearing matching (4 confidence levels)

acceptanceCriteria: «چک‌ها» page: tabs received / issued / collateral; filters (state, party, bank, due-date range, source site|manual, sayad_status, storage_location); intake queue tab (registered + age, reminders); manual entry form (received/issued, commercial/collateral); cheque card actions: confirm leaf receipt (four Sayyad items checklist + inquiry receipt attachment), Sayyad inquiry (color with inquiry date, item matching, transfer chain, issuer back-cheques; manual receipt form + SMS code guide), deposit/clear/bounce/endorse/return/void, custody move (cashbox↔vault, no journal, custody_log entry), scan/photo attachment, endorsement chain timeline

All 17 cheque reports visible with real/seed data (§5 §7 + §7.5): 1 upcoming/overdue receivables, 2 future payables ('چقدر چک دادیم'), 3 bounced, 4 in-clearing (days-in-clearing + aging flag), 5 endorsed (supplier vs other separate), 6 collateral ('چقدر چک پشتوانه کردیم' — received/issued separate, memorandum balance + secured-obligation dimension, COMPLETELY separate from commercial reports), 7 notes receivable/payable balance (reference from Tryton, not recomputed; purpose=payment only), 8 checkbook status, 9 cheque book (full registry), 10 site↔Sayyad↔leaf mismatches, 11 site-registered never-arrived (incl. expired_unreceived), 12 clearing matching rate (exact/probable/ambiguous/unmatched + unmatched list), 13 inquiry ledger (color distribution, count by channel, AGGREGATE COST: SMS 350 Toman / Ehrazino 1,700 Toman / Fintech per contract), 14 cheque cash forecast (expected clearings + expected passes by week/month; collateral excluded), 15 customer cheque statement (cheques held + in clearing + historical bounced + latest color with date), 16 cheques by storage location, 17 transfer/endorsement history timeline

Treasury dashboard: today's money, money in transit (cheques in clearing), 'چقدر چک دادیم' and 'چقدر چک پشتوانه کردیم' side by side, due-date alerts; report 2 widget shows real withdrawable balance = bank balance − uncleared issued cheques

Cheque settings (per installation): clearing window, leaf-arrival deadline, auto-post policy (default draft), bounce destination, Fintech/Ehrazino connections; bounced-cheque handling: destination choice + reason/certificate + dunning start; collateral call-in approval per case (accountant); voiding an issued cheque (issued → voided)

E2E: site registration → intake without journal → leaf receipt + Sayyad confirmation → held with journal → clearing → bank-matched clear; exception scenarios (bounce, three-way mismatch, never-arrived, duplicate sayad_id, cancellation after held, stale in-clearing); collateral segregation e2e; Toman→Rial conversion with the 24-field sample payload; sayad_id uniqueness (identical re-register idempotent, different → conflict); no raw Fintech PII in the DB; bounce journal in the CURRENT period (closed-period test)

Frontend gates: tsc 0, lint 0, build green, vitest green, Playwright cheque specs green (run against pnpm start, TRYTON_BASE_URL set); Persian RTL, VibeFarsi facade, fa() digits, Jalali dates, logical Tailwind only, 44px tap targets
